extra.reason:
Fix invite command deadlock: host_with_client_inner wrapped Hub in Arc<tokio::sync::Mutex> but hub.run() holds the lock forever (accept loop never returns until shutdown). All command handlers (invite, peers, send, quit) tried to lock the same mutex — permanent deadlock.

Fix: Don't wrap Hub in Arc<Mutex>. Extract shared state (address, peers Arc<PeerRegistry>, broadcast_tx) before handing Hub ownership to the background task. Use a watch channel for shutdown signaling instead of locking the hub.
